title: A Hundred Summers / Global June–August
premise: A hundred years of summer temperatures, where the chart itself tells the story.
comparison_notes: Original procedural 20-second study, 1280x720 at 24 fps; qualitative comparison to a longer upstream production. Global June–August anomalies for 1925–2024 from NASA GISS/GISTEMP v4; all 100 published JJA values preserved, baseline 1951–1980. NASA data public domain with attribution; FACTS.md and frozen CSV included.
